prd_facts.fact: The PRD keeps every promotions rule PRM-01 to PRM-13 with the same meaning: no product rule is added, changed or removed.
The PRM-05 discount order is unchanged: category sale, buy-x-get-y, percent coupon, bundle, fixed coupon, free-shipping flag.
The PRM-11 cap of 40% of the eligible list subtotal and the PRM-12 gift card exclusion are unchanged.
The Source column of promotions rules points to real symbols; a row whose symbol moved points to the new module and nothing else in the row changes.
The promotions technical map lists the new modules the engine was split into and what each holds.
The promotions invariants and folder CLAUDE.md are updated to the new modules, and the engine is no longer listed as a big file when it is under the limit.
